title: Application (Bewerbung): CV and motivation letter for one job ad, on one page
description: One application for one job ad, in the ad's language: the base dataset's facts, selected and worded for the ad in the order of docs/cv-guide.md, the motivation letter at the end and the company's colours. Public once merged, except `note`, `evidence`, `job.requirements` and `brand.source` (never rendered). Cross-field rules (base ids, requirement gaps, colour contrast, word limits) are enforced in scripts/lib/validate.mjs. See docs/applications.md.

language.description: Page language: the language of the job ad.

photo.description: Own portrait for this application (a file next to the base dataset).

job.description: The job ad this application answers. Without an ad there is no application: the requirements decide what the page shows.

requirements.description: Keyword analysis of the ad, never rendered: each requirement, its weight and the base entries that answer it. An empty evidence list is a gap and needs `gap`.

brand.description: Company colours of this application (not design-system tokens). The page's colour tokens are derived from them and checked for contrast (DESIGN.md, Company colours).

source.description: Where the colours come from (never rendered).

accentText.description: Optional colour for text in the accent (links, target role); must reach 4.5:1. Without it the accent is used, moved towards the ink until it does.

marks.description: Optional decorative colours (e.g. a logo's colours), used only for the page stripe and the marks of the three key strengths; never for text or as the only carrier of meaning.

branche.description: The Branche of the employer (owner's model '4 Berufsfamilien x 4 Branchen', 2026-09-27). It sets the style recipe of the page, today its one typeface (BRANCHEN in site/templates.mjs). Without it, the page uses Instrument Sans.

profile.description: Kurzprofil: who I am, in a few sentences (max. 110 words).

strengths.description: The three strongest competencies for this ad, each with its proof (max. 45 words).

experience.description: Tailoring of base positions; every base position is always shown. `compact` shows date, role and organisation only (older positions).

education.description: Tailoring of base education entries: a replacement for the short sentence.

knowledge.description: Weitere Kenntnisse: keywords for the ad in a few groups, without levels.

interests.description: Optional selection from the base interests for this ad.

omit.description: Base sections left out on this page.

evidence.description: Base entry ids (experience, education, certifications, activities, languages). Never rendered.
